name: Plongeur Aquatique
description: Cité flottante sur les océans stellaires, Plongeur Aquatique maîtrise l'élément Eau. Son équipement pressurisé lui permet de naviguer dans les courants les plus dangereux, loin des contraintes des mondes arides.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy mineral‑mining pressure suit: thick rust‑orange and patina‑green plating, massive spherical helmet filled with cyan bioluminescent water, exposed copper cooling coils, corrugated steam hoses, heavy hydraulic pistons, integrated decompression valves.
loadout.arsenal: Primary: integrated plasma geyser cannon (high‑pressure cyan plasma jet); Secondary: hydraulic thermal circular saw arm; Utility: high‑pressure water jet for crowd control.

attitude.behavior: Hovering protectively above a cluster of translucent eggs, hydraulic pistons whirring, steam venting from joints, scanning surroundings with glowing cyan eyes while the alien's tentacles pulse with bioluminescence.
attitude.emotion: Fierce, unwavering vigilance; a cold, ancient protectiveness mixed with readiness for violent confrontation.

palette_names.name: Cyan Bioluminescent
palette_names.role: Water in helmet, energy shields, bioluminescent skin accents

palette_names.name: Orange Thermal
palette_names.role: Plasma weapons, thermal vents, steam glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic directional lighting: cyan rim light from the helmet water, orange/white highlights from plasma and thermal elements, deep shadows with high contrast. Rim lighting emphasizes silhouette.
color_and_light.mood: Menacing yet protective, tense, epic atmosphere of desperate survival.

scenography.setting: Abyssal industrial nursery: a massive spherical pressure tank filled with cyan‑glow water, translucent membrane walls enclosing clusters of alien eggs, metallic bulkheads scarred by micro‑meteorite impacts, exposed thermal pipes, steam vents, and flickering emergency lights.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Rising bubbles, swirling steam clouds, bioluminescent glow pulsating from the eggs, orange plasma sparks from the weapon, occasional holographic warning signs, ambient underwater pressure distortion.
